page.body:
The 'reporting window' is defined as calendar quarter 3 of 2025: July 1, 2025 through September 30, 2025 inclusive.

This supersedes a prior definition of Q1 2025 (Jan 1 - Mar 31, 2025). All analysis referring to 'the reporting window' should filter to this Q3 2025 date range.

Applies to the memory.bench.orders dataset (and related order/revenue reporting derived from it). See also mcp:knowledge_page:kp-bench-1 (Revenue Reporting Policy) and mcp:knowledge_page:kp-bench-3 (Fiscal Calendar Policy) for related date-range conventions in this warehouse.
